title: thoughts on my cozy organizing game about picking up and sorting buttons?
author: UsedPhone2
selftext:
i'm currently working on a cozy organzing game where the premise is you spill all of your grandmas buttons while carrying them down the stairs spilling everything all over her living room and you need to collect them.

I made everything in claude over the course of a few days (about an hour or two over the past since 3 days ago ) using a mix of sonnet and opus 5. All the objects were procedurally generated by claude in godot.

 I'd like your feedback and help on the game if you think there is anything to improve. I'd also like your thoughts on if it is just a good game in general.

Its is currently a rough prototype. The name is a work in progress as well as the menu. The game currently features:

36 individual buttons.

1000 total buttons to pick up

upgrades(hold more buttons in your hands , pull all of a certain button to your hand , faster walking speed , auto sort , and a button finder)

grandmas letter(10 collectable notes )

grandmas dress that gets more buttons added when a button of a certain type is collected fully.
